title: Revoke Access Preview
summary: Shows what removing a member, token or app will break: owned work left unowned, sessions ended and integrations that stop.
description: Pre-removal readback for members, tokens or apps: what they lose, what they own with a reassign picker and one-tap reassign-all, sessions that end (flagging any in use now) and integrations that stop on their credentials. The button says if anything stays unowned.
catches: Owned items left without an owner, with reassign-to and reassign-all
Sessions that end, flagging any active within liveWithin
Integrations that stop because they run on that person's credentials
Integrations that keep running because they belong to the workspace
Confirm label that names how many items stay unowned
limits: Only knows the owned items, sessions and integrations you pass
Does not revoke anything; onConfirm receives the reassignment
a11y: Section labelled by its title; each owned item's picker has a <label>
Unowned warning in a polite live region with a one-tap fix
Stops/keeps-running stated as text, not colour alone
Confirm sets aria-busy while pending; motion skipped under reduced motion
server: Revoke tokens and sessions server-side, re-check authorization on the removal, and reassign ownership in the same transaction.
